Guides / Start here / Settings & controls

Settings & controls

Layouts, the strip, every setting, shortcuts and the PC search language.

Two layoutsSettingsShortcutsPC boxesPC searchYour save

Two layouts

  • Classic: one big window with tabs. Drag its edges or corner to size it.
  • Modular: floating windows you place anywhere over the desktop, plus the route strip above your taskbar.
  • Switch any time in Settings → Layout. Reset puts the strip back at the bottom centre and closes every window.

Settings

On desktop, Settings has tabs: Game, Sound, Look, Performance, Account and Help. In the browser and on phones it stays one page.

SettingWhat it does
Sound and criesBattle sounds, fanfares, cries and your own button sounds. Separate from Music, so you can have music with no sound effects.
VolumeHow loud the whole game is, music and alerts included. It only locks when Sound and cries, Music and Special alerts are all off.
MusicEvery island has its own music, and so do the Safari Zone and battles. If you played before v0.68 it starts off: turn it on under Sound and set how loud you want it.
LanguageEnglish, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Português (Brasil), 한국어, 日本語 and 简体中文. Searches work in your language as well as English.
Special alertsA chime when something needs you: a rare find waiting, a boss, a Gym Leader, an outbreak, a raid call or a friend. Plays even with Sound and cries off.
Mute buttons (next to Special alerts)Mute each kind on its own: raid sounds and invites, cheers and reactions, battle challenges, trade requests, friend requests and gifts, and boss, Gym and outbreak alerts. Rare-find alerts keep playing. Muted requests still wait in Friends → Inbox.
Frame rate (Performance tab)Desktop only. 30, 60 or 120 while you play, and 15, 30 or 60 while you use another app. Higher uses more of your PC.
HD spritesSmooth HD sprites; off = the original pixel sprites.
Battle rare finds myselfShiny, Void, Prismatic finds and new costumes wait 2 minutes for you to battle them yourself; then the team takes over.
Start with WindowsTallgrass opens when your PC starts, so the hunt never stops.
Use all monitorsSpread Tallgrass over every monitor (off = main monitor only). It stays as you set it through updates.
Hardware accelerationDraws with your graphics card. Turn it off if the game crashes or stutters (next launch).
Hide / CloseHide to the tray: the team keeps hunting at full speed. Close: the game saves and the team hunts at 1/3 speed until you're back.
The stripBackground (island scene or clear), size and opacity; always-on-top pin.
Log in with DiscordNeeded for friends, trades, raids and the Night Market. Your save stays on your PC.
Redeem a codeCodes from the Tallgrass team (Discord, streams, events). One use per trainer.
Support (Help)Opens the game's Patreon page, to follow its development. Nothing is behind a paywall: everything in the game stays free.

Shortcuts

  • Esc closes the top window (a search box's Esc clears it first).
  • Hold Alt while dragging or sizing a window to place it freely (no snapping).
  • The hatch reveal can wait: Esc or its X puts it away; the eggs stay unopened.
  • Click your Buddy on the route to play with it (a daily heart).

PC boxes

  • Boxes grow as you catch: there's always one empty box at the end, with no limit.
  • The wallpaper picker has Apply to all boxes; new boxes take that wallpaper too.
  • The box bar's HD / Pixel switch changes every sprite at once (the same switch as HD sprites in Settings).
  • Filters include Evolves into a new Pokédex entry, Can still evolve, Fully evolved and Can Mega Evolve (regional forms don't count as evolutions), next to Ready to evolve.
  • Natures show on the card's stats: the raised stat in green with a "+", the lowered one in red with a "−", and "+Atk −SpA" next to the nature's name.
  • A Pokémon cries when you open its card (with Sound on).

PC search

The Party & PC search works like Pokémon GO: a space means AND, a comma means OR, ! means NOT.

Your save

Your save lives on your computer (Windows: %APPDATA%\Glowbugs Hunt\save.json) and carries over every update. Back it up any time.

Your panel layout (window places and sizes, the strip, PC box and sort, sound and sprite choices) is kept next to it in layout.json, so your layout and monitor settings stay put through updates.
